INSPECTOR.KEYWORDS_HINT: Separate with commas. Accents and case are ignored.
INSPECTOR.COOLDOWN_HINT: After running, or after an agent replies, the bot waits this long before running again in the same conversation.
INSPECTOR.TIMEOUT: Give up without an answer after (minutes)
INSPECTOR.TIMEOUT_HINT: If the customer does not answer the menu or question in this time, the bot leaves the conversation.
INSPECTOR.SET_PENDING: Keep the conversation Pending while the bot talks
INSPECTOR.SET_PENDING_HINT: It leaves the Waiting tab and comes back as Open when handed to the team.
INSPECTOR.ONLY_UNASSIGNED: Only in conversations without an agent
INSPECTOR.ONLY_UNASSIGNED_HINT: If an agent takes over, the bot leaves the conversation.
INSPECTOR.FORMAT_HINT: On WhatsApp: *bold*, _italic_, ~strike~. Tap a variable to insert it.
INSPECTOR.DELAY_HINT: Leaves a pause between messages, like a person typing. Up to 30 s.
INSPECTOR.BUTTON_LABEL_HINT: Up to 20 characters. E.g. See options, MENU.
INSPECTOR.INVALID_TEXT: When the answer is not an option

INSPECTOR.MAX_ATTEMPTS_HINT: After that it follows the Invalid answer output (or hands off to the team when it is not connected).

PALETTE.DROP_FILE: Drop to create the block with this file

TEST.TITLE: Test the flow
TEST.SUBTITLE: You chat as the customer {name}. Nothing is sent.
TEST.PLACEHOLDER: Write as if you were the customer...
TEST.FINISHED_PLACEHOLDER: The flow ended. Restart to test again.
TEST.TRIGGER_UNASSIGNED_MESSAGE: In a real conversation the flow starts with any customer message without an agent. Send a message to start.
TEST.TRIGGER_NEW_CONVERSATION: In a real conversation the flow starts on the first message of a conversation. Send a message to start.
TEST.TRIGGER_KEYWORD: The flow starts when the customer writes one of these words: {words}
TEST.KEYWORD_MISS: This message has none of the Start keywords, so the bot would not start.
TEST.INVALID_DEFAULT: Sorry, I did not get that 🤔 Please choose one of the options below.
TEST.INVALID_LIMIT: Invalid answer again: the bot follows the Invalid answer output.
TEST.HANDOFF: Conversation handed off to the team. The bot leaves the conversation.
TEST.HANDOFF_TO: Conversation handed off to {target}. The bot leaves the conversation.
TEST.END_RESOLVED: End of the flow. The conversation is marked resolved.
TEST.NO_ARROW: No arrow leaves this point: the flow ends.
TEST.NO_START: This flow has no Start block.
TEST.TOO_MANY_STEPS: The flow went through more than {count} blocks in a row without waiting for the customer (is there a loop?). The bot stops here.
TEST.ALREADY_FINISHED: The flow already ended. Restart to test again.
TEST.CONFIRM_WRITE: {block} will change data on the other system. Call it for real in this test?
TEST.CONFIRM_FIRST: First answer the question above: call for real or skip.
TEST.SKIPPED: Call skipped: follows {port}, with no saved response.
TEST.DOCUMENTS_FOUND: Find document found {count} files: the customer picks from a list.
TEST.CHOOSE_DOCUMENT: I found this document: | I found {count} documents. Which one do you want?
TEST.CHOICE_LIMIT: Invalid answer again: follows Not found.
TEST.DOCUMENT_LINK:
Here is your document: {link}
(the link is valid for {days} days)
TEST.FAILURE_HANDOFF: It failed (or found nothing) and that output has no arrow: the bot hands the conversation to the team.
TEST.TOO_MANY_CALLS: More than {count} calls to other systems in a single customer message (is there a loop in the flow?). Follows Error.

LIST.TITLE: Bot automation
LIST.DESCRIPTION: Flows that answer customers on their own: WhatsApp menus with lists or buttons, free-text questions, business hours and handoff to the team. An agent who replies or takes the conversation removes the bot from it.
LIST.EXAMPLE_HINT: Creates a ready-to-adapt flow: the customer asks for a copy, the bot checks in your system that the WhatsApp number is the one on file, finds the document in Nextcloud and sends it.
LIST.EMPTY: No flows yet. Create the first one with New flow: it comes with a ready start to adjust.
LIST.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the flow {name}? Conversations in progress with the bot stop.
LIST.STATS: Last 7 days: {started} started · {handedOff} handed off · {finished} finished
LIST.ORDER_HINT: With more than one flow on in the same inbox, only one runs at a time: keyword first, then new conversation, then message without agent.

TABS_DESCRIPTION.connections: The systems the bot can call: APIs (ERP, tax, CRM), Supabase, PostgreSQL databases, GraphQL, webhooks and Nextcloud. Passwords and keys are stored encrypted and never come back to the screen.
TABS_DESCRIPTION.datasets: Excel or CSV spreadsheets the bot looks up in the Spreadsheet lookup block: prices, stock, orders, tax IDs. To change the data, use Update and upload the new version.
TABS_DESCRIPTION.logs: Every call the bot made to another system and every spreadsheet lookup in the last 7 days: what was asked, how long it took and the error, if any.

WARNINGS.NO_VALUE: Enter the value to look for.

TEST.DOCUMENTS: Found {count} documents: the customer would pick from a list.

TEST.PREVIEW_FILE: The customer would receive the file {name}.

API.READ_HINT: Read only: nothing changes on the other system.
API.WRITE_HINT: Changes data on the other system (create, update or delete).
API.JSON_HINT: Inside quotes a variable goes in as text; outside quotes, as a number or JSON.
API.GRAPHQL_HINT: query only reads; mutation changes data and needs “Allow changing data” on the connection.
API.READ_ONLY: The connection is read-only and this call changes data: it will fail. Turn on “Allow changing data” on the connection.
API.VARIABLE_HINT: The whole response goes to {variable} and the HTTP code to {status}.
API.MAPPINGS_HINT: Test the block and click a response field, or type its path (e.g. customer.name).
API.CACHE_HINT: The same query within this time uses the saved response: faster, and fewer calls to the other system.

DB.READ_ONLY: Read-only connection: SELECT works; the database rejects INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.
DB.WRITABLE: This connection allows changing data: INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE run for real.
DB.SQL_HINT: E.g.: {example}. Variables are sent as safe parameters (no SQL injection risk). One statement per block.
DB.VARIABLE_HINT_FIRST: Use {first} for a column of the row found. {count} says how many rows the statement read or changed.
DB.VARIABLE_HINT_ALL: Use {item} for the first row in the list. {count} says how many rows the statement read or changed.

CONNECTIONS.EMPTY: No connections yet. Choose the kind of system to start:
CONNECTIONS.UNUSED: Not used in a flow yet
CONNECTIONS.TEST_HTTP: Connected: the system answered {status} in {ms} ms.
CONNECTIONS.TEST_POST_ONLY: The server answered {status} to the test (GET). That is normal for a webhook that only accepts POST: test it for real with Test on the Call API block.
CONNECTIONS.TEST_POSTGRES: Connected to database {database} as {user} ({version}) in {ms} ms.
CONNECTIONS.DELETE_IN_USE: This connection is used in: {flows}. Delete anyway? Those blocks will follow their error output.

api.TITLE: API (REST)
api.HINT: ERP, tax system, CRM or any API with an address and a key
api.HELP: Paste the API base address (e.g. https://erp.company.com/api) and the key. In the blocks you only write the path, like /customers.

supabase.TITLE: Supabase
supabase.HINT: Supabase tables through the REST API
supabase.HELP: Use the Project URL and a project key (Project Settings > API Keys). In the blocks, the path is the table, e.g. /customers?tax_id=eq.123. For direct SQL, add a PostgreSQL database with the Supabase connection string.

postgres.TITLE: PostgreSQL database
postgres.HINT: Supabase, Railway, Neon, Render or your own server
postgres.HELP: Paste the connection string from the database dashboard (Railway: Variables > DATABASE_PUBLIC_URL; Supabase: Connect > Session pooler; Neon: Connection string). Prefer a read-only user.

graphql.TITLE: GraphQL
graphql.HELP: The API base address and the token. In the Call API block, choose GraphQL and write the query.

webhook.TITLE: Webhook
webhook.HINT: Notify another system or automation (n8n, Make, Zapier)
webhook.HELP: Paste the webhook URL. The Call API block sends the data by POST. “Allow changing data” comes turned on.

nextcloud.TITLE: Nextcloud
nextcloud.HINT: Find and send documents from the cloud
nextcloud.HELP: Use a Nextcloud user that only sees the folders the bot may see, with an app password (Personal settings > Security > Devices & sessions).

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.BASE_URL_HINT: Starts with https://. The blocks add the path.
FORM.NEXTCLOUD_URL_HINT: The same one you open in the browser.
FORM.APP_PASSWORD_HINT: Create one in Personal settings > Security > Devices & sessions. Don't use the regular password.
FORM.ROOT_FOLDER_HINT: The bot only sees this folder and the ones inside it.
FORM.CLIENT_AUTH: How to send the client ID
FORM.SECRET_HEADERS_HINT: Each header with its secret value. Leave a value blank to keep the saved one.
FORM.TEST_PATH_HINT: A simple read-only GET, e.g. /status. Empty: tests the base URL.
FORM.ALLOW_WRITE_HINT: When off, only GET and GraphQL queries work. Turn on for POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE and mutations.
FORM.ALLOW_WRITE_DB: When off, the bot only reads (the database rejects the rest). Turn on for INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.
FORM.SAVED_SECRET: Saved. Leave blank to keep it.
FORM.CONNECTION_STRING_HINT: E.g.: {example}. The password is stored encrypted; the rest shows in the list.
FORM.SUPABASE_KEY_HINT: The anon key follows Supabase access rules (RLS); service_role sees everything. Prefer anon with rules.

DATASETS.EMPTY: Click to upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file. The first row with data becomes the column names.
DATASETS.HINT: While a spreadsheet is being updated, the bot keeps using the old version until the new one finishes uploading.
DATASETS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the spreadsheet {name}? Blocks that use it will follow Not found.
DATASETS.NAME: Name in the bot
DATASETS.NAME_HINT: How it shows in the Spreadsheet lookup block.
DATASETS.READ_SUMMARY: {rows} rows and {columns} columns. The first ones:
DATASETS.HEADER_HINT: The first row with data became the column names. If it isn't the header, fix the spreadsheet and upload it again.

ERRORS.not_xlsx: This doesn't look like an Excel file (.xlsx). Open it in Excel and save it again as .xlsx or CSV.
ERRORS.unsupported_xlsx: This .xlsx uses a format the browser can't read. Save it again in Excel (Save as > Excel Workbook) or as CSV.
ERRORS.no_rows: It only has the header: no data rows.
ERRORS.too_many_rows: The spreadsheet has more than {max} rows. Split it into smaller parts.
ERRORS.too_many_columns: The spreadsheet has {count} columns and the limit is {max}. Delete the columns the bot doesn't use.
ERRORS.old_format: Old format (.xls, .ods or Numbers). Save it as .xlsx or CSV and upload it again.
ERRORS.invalid_generation: Another update of this spreadsheet started at the same time. Try again.
ERRORS.empty_upload: No rows reached the server. Try again.

LOGS.OPEN_BLOCK: Open the block in the flow
LOGS.EMPTY: Nothing logged in the last 7 days. Calls show up here when a flow with integration blocks runs or when you test a connection.
LOGS.RETENTION_NOTE: The log keeps 7 days and then deletes itself. Passwords and keys never show here.
